4. CYP3A4 Induction & Inhibition Time Courses
Inhibition Kinetics: Competitive inhibition (e.g., Fluconazole) occurs almost immediately with peak plasma drug levels.
Mechanism-based (irreversible/suicide) inhibition (e.g., Clarithromycin, Ritonavir, Grapefruit juice) destroys the enzyme; full CYP3A4
recovery requires de novo enzyme synthesis taking 3 to 7 days after discontinuing the offending inhibitor.
Induction Kinetics: Transcriptional activation mediated by PXR (Pregnane X Receptor) takes 7 to 14 days to reach maximum
enzymatic expression following initiation of Rifampin or Carbamazepine. Similarly, enzymatic de-induction persists for 2 to 3 weeks
after stopping the inducer.
